function: Excluded for system: Bayesian over-the-air FL aggregation (area 7) on a single-antenna link without RIS; signal model has only F sub-channels with scalar gains (pp. 4-5).
notes: Excluded as system (code 6). The paper proposes Bayesian federated learning with AirComp aggregation of posterior statistics and closed-form transmit power control (pp. 2, 6-7, 9), so it passes the learning, layer and function checks as area 7. The link is single-antenna with no RIS: p. 4 says each OFDM symbol can "convey up to F analog values over F orthogonal sub-channels" and the received signal (Eq. 9) is a Hadamard product of F-dimensional gain vectors; p. 5 gives a scalar Rayleigh gain per sub-channel. Fig. 1 (p. 4) shows one BS and single devices. The paper never mentions antennas, MIMO, beamforming or RIS, and never writes the words single antenna, so the reviewer should confirm this reading. Criteria not graded.
